fato_historico: 1966: Purges of intellectuals and imperialists becomes official China policy at the beginning of the Cultural Revolution.
energia_do_dia: Today, your dual nature may feel a spark of deep introspection. Much like the historical shifts in the pursuit of knowledge and ideology, you might consider how your own perspectives evolve. It is a good time to clear away outdated thoughts and replace them with fresh, expansive ideas that help you connect more deeply with the world around you.
frase_do_dia: Your mind is a vast garden; tend to it with kindness and purpose today.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of inner wisdom and the pursuit of truth.
conselho: Prioritize open conversations and listen deeply to the perspectives of others around you.
